modo_espacio.que_hace: Starfield and nebulas in the background, panels like a spaceship dashboard and a futuristic font. It only changes the look.
modo_espacio.activar: For science fiction shows or when you want a booth with style.
modo_espacio.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a play about astronauts or a planetarium event.
modo_espacio.desactivar: In very dark booths Night mode is better, it glares less.
modo_espacio.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a show with long blackouts where the screen is seen from the stalls.

nuevo_show.que_hace: Creates an empty show in the folder and with the name you choose, and opens it. The current one is saved first.
nuevo_show.activar: To start a project from scratch; an empty folder for it is best.
nuevo_show.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you start preparing the company's new play.
nuevo_show.desactivar: If you just want to keep working on an existing show, use Open.
nuevo_show.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you pick up yesterday's show to fix two cues.

menu_paneles.que_hace: Tick a panel to show it in the Studio view, untick it (or press its ×) to hide it. Remembered on this computer.
menu_paneles.activar: Show only what this show needs.
menu_paneles.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: for a gala with many videos you turn on the Multiview and the Mixer.
menu_paneles.desactivar: Hide what you never use so the rest gets more room.
menu_paneles.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a play with no sound board: you hide the Sound board and Sources.

bloquear_paneles.que_hace: Hides the ⋮⋮ handles so no panel can be moved by mistake. Showing and hiding still works.
bloquear_paneles.activar: When the layout is ready for the show.
bloquear_paneles.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: before opening the house, so a hurried click doesn't move Controls.
bloquear_paneles.desactivar: While you are still arranging the screen.
bloquear_paneles.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: at the first technical rehearsal you are still trying layouts.

panel_controles.que_hace: GO, Pause, Fade all and Stop all can be moved but never hidden: in an emergency they must be at hand.
panel_controles.activar: It is always on; move it near where you look most.
panel_controles.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you put it next to the Multiview to fire without looking away.
panel_controles.desactivar: It cannot be turned off, on purpose.
panel_controles.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: even with everything else hidden, Stop all is still there.

paneles.que_hace: Drag a panel's ⋮⋮ handle to move it (or select it and use ← →). It is remembered on this computer.
paneles.activar: Put what you use most close together.
paneles.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: at a gala you leave a big Multiview on the left with Controls next to it.
paneles.desactivar: If you got lost, View → Reset view puts it back as it was.
paneles.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: another operator moved everything and you can't find the Mixer.

corte_rapido.que_hace: Sends the Preview live instantly, with a cut, even if the chosen transition is a fade.
corte_rapido.activar: For emergencies or hits that must land exactly.
corte_rapido.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the house lights failed and the notice slide must go up now.
corte_rapido.desactivar: For normal changes use GO, with the chosen transition.
corte_rapido.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the calm change from the sunrise video to the midday one.

palanca.que_hace: Drag it down: the new scene appears over what is live. It can stay halfway; at the bottom it finishes like a GO; at the top everything goes back.
palanca.activar: When the fade has to follow the scene, slower or faster.
palanca.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the sea video appears as the actress walks into the water.
palanca.desactivar: If the change has a fixed time, GO with a fade is safer.
palanca.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the rehearsed 2 s fade between scene 3 and 4.

volumen_vivo.que_hace: Raises or lowers what is playing now, without touching the volume saved in the show. Mouse wheel: 0.5 dB; Shift: fine; double click: reset.
volumen_vivo.activar: To adjust on the spot for the room and the actors.
volumen_vivo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the audience claps loudly and you raise the exit music a bit.
volumen_vivo.desactivar: If you want it to stay that way, change it in the cue (Edit).
volumen_vivo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: in every rehearsal the rain covers the actors: lower it in the cue.

multivista.que_hace: Shows every scene in a grid, with a picture of each, to pick with one click.
multivista.activar: At events with no fixed order, when you need to find a scene fast.
multivista.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a gala where the host changes the running order.
multivista.desactivar: In a rehearsed play in order, the Scenes list is enough.
multivista.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the 30th performance of a play you run by heart.

mv_orden.que_hace: List: like the cue list. Free: you arrange them by dragging, in groups. Type and Name: they sort themselves.
mv_orden.activar: Free to build your own board, with groups per act or moment.
mv_orden.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an "Opening" group, an "Awards" group and a "Closing" group.
mv_orden.desactivar: List if you want the same order as the script.
mv_orden.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a play where scenes always go in order.

mv_movimiento.que_hace: Video cards flip through a few pictures to show the video. All of them, only the one under the mouse, or none.
mv_movimiento.activar: "On mouse hover" is recommended: you see the video without loading the computer.
mv_movimiento.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you look for which of three similar videos is the storm.
mv_movimiento.desactivar: "None" on modest computers or if the motion distracts you.
mv_movimiento.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an old laptop that is also sending 4K video to the projector.

mv_mov_cue.que_hace: ▶ or ⏸ on a card changes only that scene, over the general setting.
mv_mov_cue.activar: To see in motion only the videos you care about.
mv_mov_cue.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you keep the two similar videos moving and the rest still.
mv_mov_cue.desactivar: To keep a distracting scene still.
mv_mov_cue.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a video of flashing lights.

mv_escucha.que_hace: The 🎧 on each card plays the scene on Headphones only. Never in the house: the program won't let you use the same card.
mv_escucha.activar: To check a sound without the audience hearing it.
mv_escucha.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: before GO, you confirm it is the right music and not the old version.
mv_escucha.desactivar: With no headphones chosen nothing plays: choose them in Show settings.
mv_escucha.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a computer with a single sound output.

mv_tamano.que_hace: Smaller cards fit more scenes; bigger ones show each picture better.
mv_tamano.activar: Big if you have few scenes or a big screen.
mv_tamano.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an 8-video show on a 27-inch monitor.
mv_tamano.desactivar: Small if the show has many scenes.
mv_tamano.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a gala with 60 backgrounds and curtains.

mv_filtro.que_hace: Shows everything, or only videos, images or audio.
mv_filtro.activar: To find things faster among many scenes.
mv_filtro.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: only images, to pick the background for the next act.
mv_filtro.desactivar: Go back to "Everything" to see the whole show.
mv_filtro.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: before starting, to check nothing is missing.

mv_grupos.que_hace: In Free order, group scenes under a title. Drag scenes from one group to another; click the name to rename it.
mv_grupos.activar: To split by acts, by artists or by moments of the event.
mv_grupos.desactivar: One group is enough for short shows.

cabina.que_hace: Full screen with only the monitors, panels and controls. Leave it with the same option or F11.
cabina.activar: During the show, so nothing distracts and everything is bigger.
cabina.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a small laptop in a tight booth.
cabina.desactivar: While preparing the show, because the menus are hidden.
cabina.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the afternoon before opening night, adding cues.

distribuciones.que_hace: Saves under a name how the panels, the sound board and the Multiview are arranged, to bring them back with one click.
distribuciones.activar: If you run different shows on the same computer.
distribuciones.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: "My gala" with a big Multiview and "My play" with only Scenes.
distribuciones.desactivar: If you always work the same way, you don't need it.

rendimiento_auto.que_hace: The window looks complete and, if it notices it is stuttering, switches to Light mode and tells you. Sound and projector are never touched.
rendimiento_auto.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you use the same program on your PC and on the theater's.
rendimiento_auto.desactivar: Choose Light directly if you know the computer is modest.
rendimiento_auto.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an old laptop that also outputs 4K video.

rendimiento_liviano.que_hace: No animations, glows or Multiview motion. The window uses the least possible.
rendimiento_liviano.activar: On modest computers or when projector and sound need everything.
rendimiento_liviano.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an office PC borrowed for the show.
rendimiento_liviano.desactivar: On normal computers Automatic looks better.
rendimiento_liviano.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: your PC with its own graphics card.

at_juego_minimo.que_hace: Keeps only GO, Stop all, Pause, Fade all, Save and the faders on. Everything else is turned off.
at_juego_minimo.activar: If someone new is operating or keys might be pressed by mistake.
at_juego_minimo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a colleague who never used the program operates tomorrow.
at_juego_minimo.desactivar: If you know the program, the recommended set is faster.
at_juego_minimo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you have been running the same show for months.

at_juego_recomendado.que_hace: The factory shortcuts: the usual ones on and the riskier Studio view ones off.
at_juego_recomendado.activar: It is the starting point for almost everyone.
at_juego_recomendado.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the first time you set up the program.
at_juego_recomendado.desactivar: Choose another set if you need fewer or more shortcuts.
at_juego_recomendado.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you run a video event with many loose scenes.

at_juego_completo.que_hace: Turns on every shortcut, also keys 1 to 9, the T-bar keys and the Multiview with M.
at_juego_completo.activar: For experienced operators who want everything at hand, like in QLab or OBS.
at_juego_completo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a live event where you switch scenes on the keyboard without looking.
at_juego_completo.desactivar: If your sound board uses numbers, check the clashes it warns about.
at_juego_completo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: your sound board has applause on key 1.

at_go.que_hace: Fires the standby cue (or the Preview, in Studio view). Its key can change but it can't be turned off.
at_go.activar: Always on; Space is the most comfortable.
at_go.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you press GO watching the stage, without looking for the button.
at_go.desactivar: Change the key if your keyboard or external control sends another one.
at_go.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a foot pedal that sends the Enter key.

at_parar_todo.que_hace: Esc stops all sound and blacks out the projector, always, even with a menu or a dialog open.
at_parar_todo.activar: It is fixed: it is the emergency button.
at_parar_todo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an actor jumps a line and everything must stop now.
at_parar_todo.desactivar: It can't be turned off or changed, so it never fails in an emergency.
at_parar_todo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: even while typing a note, Esc stops everything.

at_pausa.que_hace: Freezes everything playing and showing; press again to continue.
at_pausa.activar: Useful in rehearsals and in shows with interruptions.
at_pausa.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the director stops the rehearsal in the middle of the music.
at_pausa.desactivar: Turn it off if you fear freezing something by mistake.
at_pausa.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a small keyboard where P sits next to another key you use.

at_fundir_todo.que_hace: Slowly lowers everything (with the length set in Show settings) to silence and black.
at_fundir_todo.activar: For soft endings or leaving a scene without a cut.
at_fundir_todo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the end of the play as the lights go down.
at_fundir_todo.desactivar: Turn it off if you use F for the sound board.
at_fundir_todo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: your sound board has an effect on key F.

at_fundir_ultimo.que_hace: Fades only the last cue that went out; the rest keeps going.
at_fundir_ultimo.activar: When several things are playing and one has to leave.
at_fundir_ultimo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the rain ends but the background music goes on.
at_fundir_ultimo.desactivar: If you never overlap cues, you don't need it.
at_fundir_ultimo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a show of videos that replace each other.

at_espera_arriba.que_hace: Moves the standby cue one up, without firing anything.
at_espera_arriba.activar: To go back to a cue that went past.
at_espera_arriba.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the actor repeats a line and the sound must play again.
at_espera_arriba.desactivar: Turn it off if you use the arrows for something else.
at_espera_arriba.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you use an external control that sends arrow keys.

at_espera_abajo.que_hace: Moves the standby cue one down, without firing anything.
at_espera_abajo.activar: To skip a cue that is not used this time.
at_espera_abajo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: today the dog scene is cut and you skip its sound.
at_espera_abajo.desactivar: Turn it off if you use the arrows for something else.
at_espera_abajo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you use an external control that sends arrow keys.

at_modo.que_hace: Tab switches between Edit (preparing) and Live (running without changing anything by mistake).
at_modo.activar: Recommended: you switch to Live quickly before starting.
at_modo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the house opens and you switch to Live with one key.
at_modo.desactivar: Turn it off if someone presses Tab by mistake during the show.
at_modo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a new operator who jumps between fields with Tab.

at_guardar.que_hace: Ctrl+S saves the show; it also saves itself every 30 s if something changed.
at_guardar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you finished adjusting the fades and want to be sure.
at_guardar.desactivar: There is no reason to turn it off.
at_guardar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: only if another program uses Ctrl+S on the same computer.

at_corte_rapido.que_hace: Sends the Preview live with a cut, even if the transition is another one (Studio view).
at_corte_rapido.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the host asks for the sponsor slide right now.
at_corte_rapido.desactivar: Turn it off if you fear sending something live by mistake.
at_corte_rapido.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an operator just learning the Studio view.

at_tbar_mas.que_hace: Moves the T-bar a little towards the new scene (manual fade in steps).
at_tbar_mas.activar: If you prefer the keyboard to the mouse for manual fades.
at_tbar_mas.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you bring in the background little by little while watching the stage.
at_tbar_mas.desactivar: Off by default: PgDn is easy to hit by mistake.
at_tbar_mas.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you use PgDn to turn the script pages in another window.

at_tbar_menos.que_hace: Moves the T-bar a little towards what is live; at the very top everything goes back.
at_tbar_menos.activar: Together with the down one, for manual fades on the keyboard.
at_tbar_menos.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you went too early and go back to the previous background.
at_tbar_menos.desactivar: Off by default: PgUp is easy to hit by mistake.
at_tbar_menos.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you use PgUp to turn the script pages in another window.

at_escenas_numero.que_hace: Each number sends a scene to the Preview (in Multiview order). It never sends it live.
at_escenas_numero.activar: At events where you pick scenes quickly without looking at the screen.
at_escenas_numero.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a DJ set with 9 backgrounds you switch to the beat.
at_escenas_numero.desactivar: Off by default: if the sound board uses numbers, the sound board wins.
at_escenas_numero.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: your sound board has laughs on 2 and applause on 3.

at_multivista.que_hace: Shows or hides the Multiview with one key.
at_multivista.activar: If you open and close it often.
at_multivista.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you open it only to find loose scenes during breaks.
at_multivista.desactivar: Off by default so it isn't hidden by mistake.
at_multivista.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: at a gala you always keep it visible.

at_cabina.que_hace: F11 enters and leaves the full-screen booth view.
at_cabina.activar: To switch quickly to the clean view before starting.
at_cabina.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the house opens and you leave only monitors and controls.
at_cabina.desactivar: Turn it off if you use F11 on the sound board.
at_cabina.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: your sound board has thunder on F11.

at_nuevo.que_hace: Ctrl+N starts an empty show (in Edit). The current one is saved first.
at_nuevo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you prepare three different presentations in one afternoon.
at_nuevo.desactivar: Turn it off if you worry about switching shows by mistake.
at_nuevo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a booth computer with a single show.

at_abrir.que_hace: Ctrl+O opens another show (in Edit). The current one is saved first.
at_abrir.activar: To switch shows quickly between performances.
at_abrir.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: there is one play in the afternoon and another at night.
at_abrir.desactivar: Turn it off if you worry about switching shows by mistake.
at_abrir.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a booth computer with a single show.

at_deshacer.que_hace: Ctrl+Z reverts the last change to the show (in Edit).
at_deshacer.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you deleted a cue by mistake.
at_deshacer.desactivar: There is no reason to turn it off; in Live it does nothing.
at_deshacer.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: while typing in a field, it undoes the text, not the show.

at_rehacer.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you undid too much and want the last change back.
at_rehacer.desactivar: There is no reason to turn it off.
at_rehacer.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: only if another program uses Ctrl+Y on the same computer.

at_agregar.que_hace: Ctrl+I opens the small window to add media to the show.
at_agregar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the final videos arrive and you add them to the show.
at_agregar.desactivar: Turn it off if you don't edit on that computer.
at_agregar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the booth computer only runs the show.

at_eliminar.que_hace: Del removes the standby cue (Ctrl+Z brings it back).
at_eliminar.activar: To clean up the show while preparing.
at_eliminar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you remove the test cues before opening night.
at_eliminar.desactivar: Turn it off if you fear deleting by mistake.
at_eliminar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a keyboard where Del sits next to the arrows.

at_subir.que_hace: Alt+↑ moves the standby cue one place up the list.
at_subir.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the director swaps two scenes.
at_subir.desactivar: Turn it off if you don't reorder with the keyboard.
at_subir.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you always reorder by dragging.

at_bajar.que_hace: Alt+↓ moves the standby cue one place down the list.
at_bajar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the director swaps two scenes.
at_bajar.desactivar: Turn it off if you don't reorder with the keyboard.
at_bajar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you always reorder by dragging.

at_buscar.que_hace: Ctrl+F goes to the cue search; Enter puts the first match on standby.
at_buscar.activar: In long shows or with no fixed order.
at_buscar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the host asks for "grandma's song".
at_buscar.desactivar: There is no reason to turn it off.
at_buscar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: only if another program uses Ctrl+F.

at_buscar2.que_hace: The / key also goes to the search, without Ctrl.
at_buscar2.desactivar: Turn it off if the sound board uses that key or you hit it by mistake.
at_buscar2.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a keyboard where / sits next to Shift.

at_ayuda.que_hace: H turns on Help mode: touch any part and it explains what it does.
at_ayuda.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you teach the program to a colleague.
at_ayuda.desactivar: Turn it off if you use H on the sound board or hit it by mistake.
at_ayuda.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you have been running the same show for months.

at_fader_rueda.que_hace: Over a fader, the wheel moves it 0.5 dB per step (Shift: 0.1; Ctrl: 3). The sound changes smoothly, without steps.
at_fader_rueda.activar: Recommended: it is the finest way to adjust live.
at_fader_rueda.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you slowly raise the ambience as the scene builds.
at_fader_rueda.desactivar: Turn it off if scrolling the page moves a fader by mistake.
at_fader_rueda.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a mouse with a very sensitive wheel.

at_fader_teclas.que_hace: With a fader selected: arrows 0.5 dB, PgUp and PgDn 3 dB, Home resets it.
at_fader_teclas.activar: To adjust precisely from the keyboard.
at_fader_teclas.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you set the master to exactly −6 dB.
at_fader_teclas.desactivar: Turn it off if you want the arrows to always move the standby cue.
at_fader_teclas.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you touched a fader and then want ↑ ↓ for the list.

abrir_show.que_hace: Saves the current show and opens another .otashow file. Everything playing must be stopped.
abrir_show.activar: To move from one show to another on the same computer.
abrir_show.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the “Blood Wedding” rehearsal is over and you start preparing “Yerma”.
abrir_show.desactivar: The show isn't changed during a performance (it's greyed out in Live mode).
abrir_show.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: in the interval, with the audience in the house, keep the same show.

medidor.que_hace: Shows how loud the house output (and headphones) is: left on top, right below.
medidor.activar: Watch it in rehearsal: green or yellow is normal; if it reaches red and LIM lights up, lower that cue.
medidor.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the final song keeps LIM on: lower its volume by 3 dB.
medidor.desactivar: If it doesn't move while something plays, check the sound output in Show settings.
medidor.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the bar stays still: sound is going to another card.

escucha.que_hace: The cue plays only in your headphones: the house hears nothing and the list doesn't move.
escucha.activar: To check a sound before its GO, even during the show.
escucha.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: with a full house, you confirm the next song is the right version.
escucha.desactivar: It needs a Headphones card in Show settings → Outputs.
escucha.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: with a single output, check the sound before opening the house.

onda.que_hace: Shows how the file sounds: tall is loud, flat is silence. The part that plays is in colour.
onda.activar: Click where you want the cue to start, and Shift + click where you want it to end.
onda.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the song has 4 s of silence at the start: click where the music begins.
onda.desactivar: If the file is already trimmed, there is no need to touch it.
onda.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an effect already cut to size in the audio editor.

botonera.que_hace: Buttons that play something on top of whatever is playing, without moving the cue on standby.
botonera.activar: For sounds with no fixed moment, or to improvise.
botonera.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a bell, laughter or thunder the director calls depending on how the scene goes.
botonera.desactivar: If everything happens in order, cues in the list are better.
botonera.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the rain that always comes in after the mother's speech.

botonera_vista.que_hace: Shows the sound board panel under the list, as a grid or a list.
botonera_vista.activar: Grid for big buttons that are easy to hit; List if there are many.
botonera_vista.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an improv show with 12 effects at hand.
botonera_vista.desactivar: Hidden if the show doesn't use a sound board: the cue list gets bigger.
botonera_vista.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a show where everything happens in order, with no loose effects.

boton_color.que_hace: The colour of the button's stripe, to spot it at a glance.
boton_color.activar: Group by colour: one colour per kind of sound.
boton_color.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: red for hits and shots, blue for ambiences, green for music.
boton_color.desactivar: Keep the same colour if there are only a few buttons.
boton_color.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a page with three bells.

boton_tecla.que_hace: A key that plays the button without the mouse: a letter (except P, F and H), a digit or F1 to F12.
boton_tecla.activar: For sounds that must hit right on time without searching with the mouse.
boton_tecla.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: key 1 for the door slam the actor cues with a gesture.
boton_tecla.desactivar: Leave it empty if you will only click it.
boton_tecla.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a spare song in case the director asks for it.

boton_repetir.que_hace: What happens if you press the button again before it ends.
boton_repetir.activar: Layer for effects that pile up; Start over to restart it.
boton_repetir.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: recorded laughter that adds to the previous one (Layer).
boton_repetir.desactivar: Stop (recommended): the second press brings it down with its fade-out.
boton_repetir.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a looping rain that is switched on and off with the same button.

luz_verde.que_hace: Checks the show and this computer before opening the house, and tells you what to look at. It changes nothing.
luz_verde.activar: Run it before every show and after changing files or outputs.
luz_verde.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you arrive at the theatre, connect everything and, before opening the house, press Check now.
luz_verde.desactivar: During the show it isn't needed: the result stays on screen.
luz_verde.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: in the interval, with everything working, don't check again.

sonando_uno.que_hace: Fades (over the Fade all time) or cuts only this cue; everything else keeps playing.
sonando_uno.activar: Fade to take out an ambience without touching the rest; Stop to cut it now.
sonando_uno.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the rain ends but the scene music goes on: Fade on the rain.
sonando_uno.desactivar: To cut everything at once use Stop all (Esc) or Fade all (F).
sonando_uno.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the end of the scene, when everything goes with the blackout.

modo_fresno.que_hace: A warm light-wood look, purely cosmetic. Everything works the same.
modo_fresno.activar: For a cosier feel during rehearsals and preparation, with good light.
modo_fresno.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you build the show in the afternoon in the rehearsal room, lights on.
modo_fresno.desactivar: In a dark booth use Night mode: the light background is glaring.
modo_fresno.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the evening performance, during a blackout.

salida_principal.que_hace: The card that carries everything the audience hears.
salida_principal.activar: Choose the card that goes to the theatre's mixing desk.
salida_principal.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the USB interface connected to the desk, instead of the monitor's speakers.
salida_principal.desactivar: Leave the default if there is only one output.
salida_principal.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a rehearsal at home with the computer speakers.

salida_auriculares.que_hace: Another card just for you, to listen to a cue without the audience hearing it.
salida_auriculares.activar: Use it if you have a second output for headphones in the booth.
salida_auriculares.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: checking the level of the final song while the house is already full.
salida_auriculares.desactivar: Leave it on Not used if you have no separate headphones connected.
salida_auriculares.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a simple show with a single output to the desk.

salida_pantalla.que_hace: Which screen shows the videos and images, full screen.
salida_pantalla.activar: Choose the projector (Windows in Extend mode: Windows + P).
salida_pantalla.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the venue's projector connected to the laptop by HDMI.
salida_pantalla.desactivar: Preview in a window if there is no projector yet.
salida_pantalla.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: building the show at home with a single monitor.

ajustes_show.que_hace: Short ramps, double-GO protection, Fade all duration and master volume. They travel with the show.
ajustes_show.activar: Open them when preparing a new show or if you hear clicks.
ajustes_show.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: GO fires twice because the operator presses hard: raise the protection.
ajustes_show.desactivar: If everything sounds right, leave them as they come.
ajustes_show.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a play whose music starts in silence: the recommended values are enough.

doble_go.que_hace: Minimum time between two GOs. A second GO sooner than that is ignored (and logged).
doble_go.activar: Raise it (500–1000 ms) if repeated GOs slip through.
doble_go.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a new operator who hits Space twice in a row during the blackout.
doble_go.desactivar: Lower it (0–100 ms) if some cues follow each other very quickly.
doble_go.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: three door knocks fired by hand, one right after another.

fundir_todo_dur.que_hace: How long Fade all (F) and Shift+F take to bring everything down, sound and image.
fundir_todo_dur.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the end of the play, with the lights going down slowly: 8 s.
fundir_todo_dur.desactivar: Shorter (1–2 s) to get out fast without a hard cut.
fundir_todo_dur.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a scene change in the dark that lasts a moment.

volumen_maestro.que_hace: Raises or lowers everything the show plays at once, without touching each cue.
volumen_maestro.activar: Lower it if everything is too loud in this venue.
volumen_maestro.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the tour reaches a small room: −6 dB and done.
volumen_maestro.desactivar: Leave it at 0 dB and adjust on the mixing desk.
volumen_maestro.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: in your usual theatre, with the desk already set.

agregar.que_hace: Adds audio, video or image files as new cues after the one on standby. Files from elsewhere are copied into the show folder.
agregar.activar: When you build the show or the director brings a new sound.
agregar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the director wants a bell before act two: drag it in after the interval cue.
agregar.desactivar: Nothing is added during the performance: the show stays fixed.
agregar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: mid-show, if a sound is missing, use one already in the list.

numero.que_hace: The number shown in the list. It can have letters and dots so it matches the prompt book.
numero.activar: Change it to match the number written in the stage manager's script.
numero.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you add a sound between 4 and 5 and number it 4.5 or 4A.
numero.desactivar: Leave it as it is if nobody calls the cues by number.
numero.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a short show you run alone, following the action.

inicio_fin.que_hace: Which second of the file the cue starts at and where it stops. A loop repeats only that part.
inicio_fin.activar: To use only part of the file without editing it elsewhere.
inicio_fin.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the song comes in at the chorus (from 42) and ends before the last verse.
inicio_fin.desactivar: Leave 0 and empty to use the whole file.
inicio_fin.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a rain effect that is already cut to size.

salida.que_hace: Where this cue plays: Main (what the audience hears) or Headphones (only you, to preview).
salida.activar: Pick Headphones to hear something without the house hearing it.
salida.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: before opening the house you check the final music is the right one, with headphones on.
salida.desactivar: Keep Main for everything that is part of the show.
salida.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the rain in scene 3 must be heard by the audience: it goes to Main.

volumen.que_hace: How loud this cue plays. 0 dB is the file as it is; negative numbers make it quieter.
volumen.activar: Lower it if the sound covers the actors; raise it a little if it can't be heard.
volumen.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the party ambience sits at −12 dB so the dialogue on top is clear.
volumen.desactivar: Leave it at 0 dB if the file is already well balanced.
volumen.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the final song already comes at the right level: leave it alone.

fundido_entrada.que_hace: The sound comes in rising slowly over those seconds, instead of starting at once.
fundido_entrada.activar: Use it so something appears softly, without the audience noticing the start.
fundido_entrada.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the wind starts as the lights go down: with 3 s it appears unnoticed.
fundido_entrada.desactivar: No fade if the sound has to hit right on the moment.
fundido_entrada.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the phone on stage rings the instant the actor looks at it.

fundido_salida.que_hace: At the end of the cue, the sound goes down slowly over those seconds until it's gone.
fundido_salida.activar: Use it if the file ends abruptly or you want a soft ending.
fundido_salida.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you trimmed the music mid-song: with a 4 s fade it ends without a cut.
fundido_salida.desactivar: No fade if the file already ends by itself, in silence.
fundido_salida.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a recorded door slam: it ends on its own, no need to touch it.

bucle.que_hace: When it ends, the sound starts again with no gap, until you stop it or fade it.
bucle.activar: Turn it on for ambiences that must last as long as the scene.
bucle.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the pre-show music while the audience comes in, or rain for a whole scene.
bucle.desactivar: Turn it off for sounds that play only once.
bucle.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the gunshot, the recorded applause or the final song.

nota.que_hace: A reminder you see before the GO, in the list and in Live mode. The audience never sees it.
nota.activar: Write when to give the GO, like in the script.
nota.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: “when the bride walks through the door” or “after the line ‘They're here!’”.
nota.desactivar: Leave it empty if the moment is obvious.
nota.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the pre-show music at the start, which goes with the first GO.

modo_noche.que_hace: Makes the screen dark and reddish so it doesn't dazzle you or light up the booth.
modo_noche.activar: Turn it on when the booth is dark during the show.
modo_noche.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: your screen is visible from the stalls during blackouts: in night mode it barely glows.
modo_noche.desactivar: Turn it off during the day or in lit rehearsals, to read better.
modo_noche.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an afternoon tech rehearsal with the house lights on.

modo_dia.que_hace: White background and maximum contrast, to read the screen in full sunlight.
modo_dia.activar: Turn it on for outdoor shows or with lots of light on you.
modo_dia.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a show in a town square at 5 pm: in day mode everything is readable.
modo_dia.desactivar: Turn it off in a dark venue: white dazzles.
modo_dia.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the evening show in the theater: go back to the dark theme.

alto_contraste.que_hace: Pure black with white text and strong borders, to see better.
alto_contraste.activar: Turn it on if the screen is hard to read or the monitor is poor.
alto_contraste.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the booth monitor is old and the greys can't be told apart.
alto_contraste.desactivar: Turn it off if you see the normal colors well.
alto_contraste.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: with a good monitor, the normal theme is easier on the eyes.

mostrar_consejos.que_hace: Shows these little “?” messages next to each option. You can always turn them back on here.
mostrar_consejos.activar: Keep them if you're learning or someone else will use the program.
mostrar_consejos.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a new colleague runs the show tomorrow and wants to understand each option.
mostrar_consejos.desactivar: Turn them off if you know the program and prefer a cleaner screen.
mostrar_consejos.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: you've run the same show for months and no longer need the explanations.

estilo_lista.que_hace: The list leads: each GO fires the next cue, in order, on top of what is playing. In Live mode you don't pick with the mouse.
estilo_lista.activar: Use it for shows with a fixed, rehearsed cue order.
estilo_lista.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a play with 80 cues that follow the script, one after another.
estilo_lista.desactivar: Switch to Studio if the order isn't fixed and you need to find cues on the fly.
estilo_lista.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a gala where the host changes the running order on the spot.

transicion.que_hace: How GO goes from what was there to the new cue. Cut: instant. Crossfade: one goes down as the other comes up. Blackout: through black.
transicion.activar: Crossfade for smooth scene changes; blackout to separate moments.
transicion.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: at a gala, a 2000 ms blackout between the introduction of each act.
transicion.desactivar: Cut when the change has to land exactly on the moment.
transicion.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the news video that bursts in when the actor turns on the TV.

transicion_dur.que_hace: How long the whole crossfade or blackout takes (the blackout uses half to go down and half to come up).
transicion_dur.activar: Between 500 and 2000 ms looks natural; longer for slow moments.
transicion_dur.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: 3000 ms from the sunrise video to the midday one in a calm scene.
transicion_dur.desactivar: At 0 ms the crossfade and the blackout become a cut.
transicion_dur.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a comedy show with quick image changes to the rhythm of the jokes.

estilo_estudio.que_hace: Click a cue: you see it in the preview without it going out. GO replaces what was there, with the chosen transition.
estilo_estudio.activar: Use it when the order isn't fixed or you want to see each video before sending it.
estilo_estudio.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an event with a video for each speaker, played as each one walks on stage.
estilo_estudio.desactivar: Go back to List for a rehearsed show, with more room for the list and fewer clicks.
estilo_estudio.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the 20th performance of a play you run by heart.

previa_movimiento.que_hace: The preview video moves (muted). Turned off, you only see a still picture.
previa_movimiento.activar: Keep it on if the computer runs well and you want to see the video before GO.
previa_movimiento.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: you're choosing between two similar videos and want to see which is which.
previa_movimiento.desactivar: Turn it off on weak computers: the preview is one more video playing at once.
previa_movimiento.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: an old laptop with a 4K video live on the projector.

salir_desde.que_hace: Choose whether the video starts from the beginning or from where you left it in the preview.
salir_desde.activar: Choose "from here" to start mid-video, with picture and sound together.
salir_desde.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the director wants the storm video to start right at the first lightning bolt.
salir_desde.desactivar: Keep "from the beginning" so it plays in full, as prepared.
salir_desde.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the opening video, which always plays complete.

encuadre.que_hace: Fit shows it whole with black bars; Fill covers the whole screen by cropping; Stretch fills it by distorting.
encuadre.activar: Use Fill if the black bars are a problem and losing a bit of the edges is fine.
encuadre.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: a vertical phone video as a bar background: Fill covers the whole wall.
encuadre.desactivar: Keep Fit if it must be seen whole, even with bars.
encuadre.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a photo with text or a map that can't lose anything.

zoom.que_hace: Makes the image bigger or smaller inside the screen. 100% is the normal size.
zoom.activar: Raise it to get closer to a detail, or lower it to leave space around.
zoom.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: zoom into the grandfather's portrait in the memory scene.
zoom.desactivar: Keep it at 100% if the video is already prepared at the right size.
zoom.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: the opening video made to fit the curtain.

mover.que_hace: Shifts the image sideways or up and down, without touching the file.
mover.activar: Move it if the important part is hidden by the set or falls off the curtain.
mover.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: raise the moon so the house in scene 2 doesn't cover it.
mover.desactivar: Keep it centered if it already lands where it should.
mover.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a sky background that fills the whole cyclorama.

recortar.que_hace: Removes a percentage of each edge of the image (what is cropped isn't shown).
recortar.activar: Crop if the file has black borders, a watermark or something that shouldn't show.
recortar.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: an online video with a logo at the bottom: crop 8% off the bottom.
recortar.desactivar: Keep it at 0 if the image is clean.
recortar.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a video made for the play, with no borders or marks.

mapeo.que_hace: Warps the whole projection so it fits a tilted surface or one seen from the side.
mapeo.activar: Use it if the projector isn't straight on or the surface isn't a straight rectangle.
mapeo.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: the projector hangs off to the side and the image lands as a trapezoid on the curtain.
mapeo.desactivar: Keep the whole screen if the projector is straight on and the image already fits.
mapeo.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: a cinema screen hung right in front of the projector.

patron.que_hace: Puts a grid with one colored corner each on the projector, so you can see what you're moving.
patron.activar: Turn it on while you fit the corners, with the house empty.
patron.ejemplo_activar: E.g.: during the get-in, to get the grid straight on the curtain.
patron.desactivar: Turn it off before the house opens: the audience shouldn't see it.
patron.ejemplo_desactivar: E.g.: half an hour before the show, with the house opening.

menubar: This is where the settings are kept, like drawers in a cupboard: File to save the show, Edit to change things, View for how it looks and Help to learn. That way the screen stays clean, with just the show buttons.
pestanas: Show is where you prepare and run the performance. Convert will change audio files into another type. You don't need it for the show: the program prepares the files by itself.
modos: There are two ways to use the program. Edit is for preparing the show, like setting up your toys before playing. Live is for the real performance: nothing can be changed, so you can't make mistakes. The Tab key switches between them and the sound doesn't stop.
conexion: The green dot means the screen is connected to the sound. If it turns red, the program tries to reconnect by itself.
luz: It is like checking your backpack before leaving: tap here and the program checks that every sound, video and image is there and works, and that the computer is ready. Green is all good, yellow means look at something, red means something will not work.
medidor: They are like sound thermometers: the fuller the bar, the louder it is. Green is fine, red is too loud. If LIM lights up, the program is turning the volume down by itself to protect the speakers.
botonera: It is like an effects keyboard: each button plays something when you press it, even if something else is already playing. It doesn't change the next cue. Esc and Fade all also turn it off.
reloj: The current time, so you know when the show starts.
lista: A cue is each thing that happens in the show: some music, a noise, a video or a picture. They're all here, in order, like a step-by-step recipe. The one with the colored border goes when you press GO. Whatever is green is playing now.
lado_edicion: Here you change the cue you picked: its name, a note to remember, whether it's louder or softer, whether it comes in slowly, whether it repeats. If it's playing, it asks you first, so you don't change it by accident.
lado_funcion: It shows what's playing now, how long until it ends and what comes next. Just to look: nothing can be changed here, so nothing breaks in the middle of the show.
go: The most important button. Every time you press it, the next thing in the list starts. It's like turning the page of a storybook. Also with the space bar.
pausa: Freezes everything, like pausing a movie. Press it again and it continues where it stopped. Also with the P key.
fundir: Lowers the sound slowly, over 3 seconds, until nothing is left. It's for ending softly. With Shift and F, only the last thing that started fades away.
parar: The emergency button. Turns everything off at once, with no nasty noises in the speakers. Also with the Esc key, which always works.
aviso: When something didn't go as expected, the program tells you here in simple words. Close it with the cross.
buscador: Type a number or part of the name and the list shows only what matches. Press Enter and that cue is ready for the next GO. Searching never fires anything.
est_centro: This button sends the Preview to Program with the transition chosen below (cut, fade or black). The T-bar does the fade by hand: lower it slowly and the new scene appears. Quick cut sends it at once.
fuentes: These are the parts of the scene you picked: the video or image, its sound, how it fits on screen and the note. The ⚙ takes you to change each one (in Edit).
mezclador: Like a tiny mixing desk: the colored bars show how loud the house and the headphones are. Each thing playing has its own knob to raise or lower it on the spot, and below is the Master that rules everything.
transiciones: They choose how one scene changes into another with GO: at once (cut), blending (fade) or through black. The length says how long it takes.
controles: The usual buttons: GO, Pause, Fade all and Stop all. You can move this panel, but it never hides.
multivista: All your scenes in sight, like cards on a table. One tap puts it in the Preview, two taps send it live. You can arrange them any way you like and group them by acts.
previa: It shows the cue you picked, before sending it to the projector. You can play it here to watch it all, muted and without the audience seeing it. Only GO sends it to the projector.
aire: It shows what's on the projector right now and how long is left. If it says Black, the projector shows nothing.
mapeo: Here you fit the image onto the stage: drag the 4 corners until it matches the curtain or the shape. With the test pattern you see the grid on the projector. It can only be changed in Edit mode.

pasos: Welcome to Otaconvert V2
In five steps I'll show you how it works. You can see this again anytime in Help → First steps.
1. The cue list
On the left is your show, in order. Each row is a cue: some music, a noise, a video or an image. The one with the colored border goes with the next GO.
2. Prepare in Edit
Tap a cue and on the right you change its name, a note, the volume and the fades. Everything saves by itself.
3. The performance in Live
With Tab you switch to Live: on the right you see big what's playing and what's next, and nothing can be changed by mistake.
4. The four buttons
GO (Space) starts the next one. Pause (P) freezes. Fade all (F) lowers everything slowly. Stop all (Esc) is the emergency button and always works.
5. If you're unsure
Open Help → Help mode (or the H key) and tap anything: I'll explain what it's for. The “?” next to each option gives you tips with examples.
6. Studio view (like OBS)

In View → Style → Studio, Preview is on the left and Program on the right. Click a scene to preview it and press GO to send it live. With View → Multiview you see all scenes as cards. Every panel can be moved.
